title: Alchemy Workflow: the ooRexx workflow planner the build runs on
purpose: Tell any model working on Alchemy what the Alchemy Workflow is, what a workflow verdict and a workflow failure report mean, what to do when one arrives, how the rule book decides what applies, and how to add a step. The Workflow will take over from the Python Autobuild stage by stage; until then it runs in shadow mode and stops nothing.
